items.q: me and Brooksie/play a lot of things... I go and sit and look at him... I got him

ctx.x: Same sound, but my idea, me. I would do that all the time. I ain't never told the guy show me how to do nothing. I go and sit and look at him. He'd do it two or three times, then while I'm getting paid on the job, I would try it, if it any good, I keep it. If it ain't no good, forget it. That's me, just my idea.
